Digging into how Glance's defaultWeight modifier is scoped.
Tracking down the gradle version mismatch.
Checking whether building the code is feasible without the full SDK.

Verifying sorting logic for a test case.
Investigating widget activity configuration in the manifest.
Checking battery optimization status through a utility function.
Fixing missing theme dependencies after removing a library.
Investigating the Android build and lint configuration issue.
Checking theme settings and night mode mapping in the code.
Checking for top-level properties initializing Android components in the file.
Deciding how much documentation to include in the fix.
Tracing usage of latLng across map components.
Debugging mismatched measure point instances across saved data.
Tracing shared measure point instances across the data flow.
Two things broke the build, and both came from the last batch of changes (the build at a0822172 was green). I went through the diff since that build, the manifest, the Java and Kotlin cross-references, and the unit tests. Nothing else is failing.

defaultWeight import: in Glance, defaultWeight() is only available inside a Row or Column block, so it can’t be imported on its own. Removing the import fixes it, because every call to it is already inside a Row.
Room type mismatch: toMeasurePoints returned a list that could hold nulls, but Room’s generated code expects a list of non-null MeasurePoint. The converter now returns ArrayList<MeasurePoint>.
While fixing this I also cleaned up MeasurePoint:

It is now immutable.
It has equals to match its existing hashCode, so removing a point from a measure loaded from the database works.
The unused setters, getLatLng and the list convertForDatabase overload are gone.
I added a test for the converter so this can’t break again silently.

The README doesn’t need changes, since none of this changes documented behaviour. Nothing needs deleting.

app/src/main/java/app/simple/positional/widgets/SunTimeWidget.kt
kotlin
package app.simple.positional.widgets

import android.content.Context
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp
import androidx.glance.GlanceId
import androidx.glance.GlanceModifier
import androidx.glance.Image
import androidx.glance.ImageProvider
import androidx.glance.appwidget.GlanceAppWidget
import androidx.glance.appwidget.GlanceAppWidgetReceiver
import androidx.glance.appwidget.provideContent
import androidx.glance.background
import androidx.glance.layout.Alignment
import androidx.glance.layout.Column
import androidx.glance.layout.Row
import androidx.glance.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.glance.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.glance.layout.padding
import androidx.glance.layout.size
import androidx.glance.text.Text
import androidx.glance.text.TextStyle
import androidx.glance.unit.ColorProvider
import app.simple.positional.R
import app.simple.positional.constants.LocationPins
import app.simple.positional.preferences.ClockPreferences
import app.simple.positional.preferences.MainPreferences
import app.simple.positional.singleton.SharedPreferences
import app.simple.positional.util.LocaleHelper
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import org.shredzone.commons.suncalc.SunTimes
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.ZonedDateTime
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
import java.util.TimeZone

class SunTimeWidget : GlanceAppWidgetReceiver() {
    override val glanceAppWidget: GlanceAppWidget = SunTimeGlance()
}

class SunTimeGlance : GlanceAppWidget() {
    override suspend fun provideGlance(context: Context, id: GlanceId) {
        SharedPreferences.init(context)
        val pin = if (MainPreferences.isCustomCoordinate()) R.drawable.ic_place_custom else LocationPins.getLocationPin()
        val pattern = if (ClockPreferences.getDefaultClockTimeFormat()) {
            DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("hh:mm a").withLocale(LocaleHelper.getAppLocale())
        } else {
            DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("HH:mm")
        }
        val times = withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
            val coordinates = if (MainPreferences.isCustomCoordinate()) MainPreferences.getCoordinates() else MainPreferences.getLastCoordinates()
            val sun = SunTimes.compute()
                .timezone(TimeZone.getDefault().id)
                .on(Instant.now())
                .latitude(coordinates[0].toDouble())
                .longitude(coordinates[1].toDouble())
                .execute()
            listOf(
                R.drawable.ic_widget_sunrise to sun.rise,
                R.drawable.ic_widget_sun_noon to sun.noon,
                R.drawable.ic_widget_sun_set to sun.set,
                R.drawable.ic_widget_sun_nadir to sun.nadir,
            ).map { (icon, time) -> icon to (time?.let(pattern::format) ?: "--") }
        }
        val updated = context.getString(R.string.last_updated) + " • " + pattern.format(ZonedDateTime.now())
        provideContent {
            Column(GlanceModifier.fillMaxSize().background(ImageProvider(R.drawable.bg_widget)).padding(10.dp)) {
                Row(GlanceModifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(10.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Image(ImageProvider(pin), contentDescription = null, modifier = GlanceModifier.size(20.dp))
                    Text(
                        updated,
                        style = TextStyle(color = ColorProvider(R.color.textTertiary)),
                        modifier = GlanceModifier.defaultWeight().padding(horizontal = 8.dp),
                    )
                    Text(context.getString(R.string.app_name), style = TextStyle(color = ColorProvider(R.color.dividerColor), fontSize = 12.sp))
                }
                Row(GlanceModifier.fillMaxSize(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    times.forEach { (icon, time) ->
                        Column(GlanceModifier.defaultWeight(), horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                            Image(ImageProvider(icon), contentDescription = null, modifier = GlanceModifier.size(36.dp))
                            Text(time, style = TextStyle(color = ColorProvider(R.color.textTertiary), fontSize = 12.sp))
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
app/src/main/java/app/simple/positional/database/converters/MeasurePointConverter.kt
kotlin
package app.simple.positional.database.converters

import androidx.room.TypeConverter
import app.simple.positional.model.MeasurePoint

class MeasurePointConverter {
    @TypeConverter
    fun fromMeasurePoints(measurePoints: ArrayList<MeasurePoint>): String =
        measurePoints.joinToString("") { it.convertForDatabase() + ";" }

    @TypeConverter
    fun toMeasurePoints(data: String?): ArrayList<MeasurePoint> =
        data.orEmpty().split(';').filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.mapTo(ArrayList()) { MeasurePoint.convertFromDatabase(it) }
}
app/src/main/java/app/simple/positional/model/MeasurePoint.java
java
package app.simple.positional.model;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;

public final class MeasurePoint {
    private final double latitude;
    private final double longitude;
    private final int order;

    public MeasurePoint(double latitude, double longitude, int order) {
        this.latitude = latitude;
        this.longitude = longitude;
        this.order = order;
    }

    public double getLatitude() {
        return latitude;
    }

    public double getLongitude() {
        return longitude;
    }

    public int getOrder() {
        return order;
    }

    public String convertForDatabase() {
        return latitude + "," + longitude + "," + order;
    }

    public static MeasurePoint convertFromDatabase(String data) {
        String[] parts = data.split(",");
        return new MeasurePoint(
                Double.parseDouble(parts[0]),
                Double.parseDouble(parts[1]),
                Integer.parseInt(parts[2]));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (!(o instanceof MeasurePoint)) return false;
        MeasurePoint that = (MeasurePoint) o;
        return Double.compare(latitude, that.latitude) == 0
                && Double.compare(longitude, that.longitude) == 0
                && order == that.order;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        int result = Double.hashCode(latitude);
        result = 31 * result + Double.hashCode(longitude);
        result = 31 * result + order;
        return result;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "MeasurePoint{" + "latitude=" + latitude + ", longitude=" + longitude + ", order=" + order + '}';
    }
}
app/src/test/java/app/simple/positional/database/converters/MeasurePointConverterTest.kt (new)
kotlin
package app.simple.positional.database.converters

import app.simple.positional.model.MeasurePoint
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class MeasurePointConverterTest {
    private val converter = MeasurePointConverter()

    @Test
    fun roundTrip() {
        val points = arrayListOf(MeasurePoint(1.5, -2.25, 1), MeasurePoint(-45.0, 170.125, 2))
        val data = converter.fromMeasurePoints(points)
        assertEquals("1.5,-2.25,1;-45.0,170.125,2;", data)
        assertEquals(points, converter.toMeasurePoints(data))
    }

    @Test
    fun emptyAndNull() {
        assertEquals("", converter.fromMeasurePoints(arrayListOf()))
        assertTrue(converter.toMeasurePoints(null).isEmpty())
        assertTrue(converter.toMeasurePoints("").isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun pointsCompareByValue() {
        val list = arrayListOf(MeasurePoint(3.0, 4.0, 1))
        list.remove(MeasurePoint(3.0, 4.0, 1))
        assertTrue(list.isEmpty())
    }
}

Ran 34 commands, read memory
Two things broke the build, and both came from the last batch of changes (the build at a0822172 was green). I went through the diff since that build, the manifest, the Java and Kotlin cross-references, and the unit tests. Nothing else is failing.

defaultWeight import: in Glance, defaultWeight() is only available inside a Row or Column block, so it can’t be imported on its own. Removing the import fixes it, because every call to it is already inside a Row.
Room type mismatch: toMeasurePoints returned a list that could hold nulls, but Room’s generated code expects a list of non-null MeasurePoint. The converter now returns ArrayList<MeasurePoint>.
While fixing this I also cleaned up MeasurePoint:

It is now immutable.
It has equals to match its existing hashCode, so removing a point from a measure loaded from the database works.
The unused setters, getLatLng and the list convertForDatabase overload are gone.
I added a test for the converter so this can’t break again silently.

The README doesn’t need changes, since none of this changes documented behaviour. Nothing needs deleting.

app/src/main/java/app/simple/positional/widgets/SunTimeWidget.kt
kotlin
package app.simple.positional.widgets

import android.content.Context
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp
import androidx.glance.GlanceId
import androidx.glance.GlanceModifier
import androidx.glance.Image
import androidx.glance.ImageProvider
import androidx.glance.appwidget.GlanceAppWidget
import androidx.glance.appwidget.GlanceAppWidgetReceiver
import androidx.glance.appwidget.provideContent
import androidx.glance.background
import androidx.glance.layout.Alignment
import androidx.glance.layout.Column
import androidx.glance.layout.Row
import androidx.glance.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.glance.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.glance.layout.padding
import androidx.glance.layout.size
import androidx.glance.text.Text
import androidx.glance.text.TextStyle
import androidx.glance.unit.ColorProvider
import app.simple.positional.R
import app.simple.positional.constants.LocationPins
import app.simple.positional.preferences.ClockPreferences
import app.simple.positional.preferences.MainPreferences
import app.simple.positional.singleton.SharedPreferences
import app.simple.positional.util.LocaleHelper
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import org.shredzone.commons.suncalc.SunTimes
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.ZonedDateTime
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
import java.util.TimeZone

class SunTimeWidget : GlanceAppWidgetReceiver() {
    override val glanceAppWidget: GlanceAppWidget = SunTimeGlance()
}

class SunTimeGlance : GlanceAppWidget() {
    override suspend fun provideGlance(context: Context, id: GlanceId) {
        SharedPreferences.init(context)
        val pin = if (MainPreferences.isCustomCoordinate()) R.drawable.ic_place_custom else LocationPins.getLocationPin()
        val pattern = if (ClockPreferences.getDefaultClockTimeFormat()) {
            DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("hh:mm a").withLocale(LocaleHelper.getAppLocale())
        } else {
            DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("HH:mm")
        }
        val times = withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
            val coordinates = if (MainPreferences.isCustomCoordinate()) MainPreferences.getCoordinates() else MainPreferences.getLastCoordinates()
            val sun = SunTimes.compute()
                .timezone(TimeZone.getDefault().id)
                .on(Instant.now())
                .latitude(coordinates[0].toDouble())
                .longitude(coordinates[1].toDouble())
                .execute()
            listOf(
                R.drawable.ic_widget_sunrise to sun.rise,
                R.drawable.ic_widget_sun_noon to sun.noon,
                R.drawable.ic_widget_sun_set to sun.set,
                R.drawable.ic_widget_sun_nadir to sun.nadir,
            ).map { (icon, time) -> icon to (time?.let(pattern::format) ?: "--") }
        }
        val updated = context.getString(R.string.last_updated) + " • " + pattern.format(ZonedDateTime.now())
        provideContent {
            Column(GlanceModifier.fillMaxSize().background(ImageProvider(R.drawable.bg_widget)).padding(10.dp)) {
                Row(GlanceModifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(10.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Image(ImageProvider(pin), contentDescription = null, modifier = GlanceModifier.size(20.dp))
                    Text(
                        updated,
                        style = TextStyle(color = ColorProvider(R.color.textTertiary)),
                        modifier = GlanceModifier.defaultWeight().padding(horizontal = 8.dp),
                    )
                    Text(context.getString(R.string.app_name), style = TextStyle(color = ColorProvider(R.color.dividerColor), fontSize = 12.sp))
                }
                Row(GlanceModifier.fillMaxSize(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    times.forEach { (icon, time) ->
                        Column(GlanceModifier.defaultWeight(), horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                            Image(ImageProvider(icon), contentDescription = null, modifier = GlanceModifier.size(36.dp))
                            Text(time, style = TextStyle(color = ColorProvider(R.color.textTertiary), fontSize = 12.sp))
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
app/src/main/java/app/simple/positional/database/converters/MeasurePointConverter.kt
kotlin
package app.simple.positional.database.converters

import androidx.room.TypeConverter
import app.simple.positional.model.MeasurePoint

class MeasurePointConverter {
    @TypeConverter
    fun fromMeasurePoints(measurePoints: ArrayList<MeasurePoint>): String =
        measurePoints.joinToString("") { it.convertForDatabase() + ";" }

    @TypeConverter
    fun toMeasurePoints(data: String?): ArrayList<MeasurePoint> =
        data.orEmpty().split(';').filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.mapTo(ArrayList()) { MeasurePoint.convertFromDatabase(it) }
}
app/src/main/java/app/simple/positional/model/MeasurePoint.java
java
package app.simple.positional.model;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;

public final class MeasurePoint {
    private final double latitude;
    private final double longitude;
    private final int order;

    public MeasurePoint(double latitude, double longitude, int order) {
        this.latitude = latitude;
        this.longitude = longitude;
        this.order = order;
    }

    public double getLatitude() {
        return latitude;
    }

    public double getLongitude() {
        return longitude;
    }

    public int getOrder() {
        return order;
    }

    public String convertForDatabase() {
        return latitude + "," + longitude + "," + order;
    }

    public static MeasurePoint convertFromDatabase(String data) {
        String[] parts = data.split(",");
        return new MeasurePoint(
                Double.parseDouble(parts[0]),
                Double.parseDouble(parts[1]),
                Integer.parseInt(parts[2]));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (!(o instanceof MeasurePoint)) return false;
        MeasurePoint that = (MeasurePoint) o;
        return Double.compare(latitude, that.latitude) == 0
                && Double.compare(longitude, that.longitude) == 0
                && order == that.order;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        int result = Double.hashCode(latitude);
        result = 31 * result + Double.hashCode(longitude);
        result = 31 * result + order;
        return result;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "MeasurePoint{" + "latitude=" + latitude + ", longitude=" + longitude + ", order=" + order + '}';
    }
}
app/src/test/java/app/simple/positional/database/converters/MeasurePointConverterTest.kt (new)
kotlin
package app.simple.positional.database.converters

import app.simple.positional.model.MeasurePoint
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class MeasurePointConverterTest {
    private val converter = MeasurePointConverter()

    @Test
    fun roundTrip() {
        val points = arrayListOf(MeasurePoint(1.5, -2.25, 1), MeasurePoint(-45.0, 170.125, 2))
        val data = converter.fromMeasurePoints(points)
        assertEquals("1.5,-2.25,1;-45.0,170.125,2;", data)
        assertEquals(points, converter.toMeasurePoints(data))
    }

    @Test
    fun emptyAndNull() {
        assertEquals("", converter.fromMeasurePoints(arrayListOf()))
        assertTrue(converter.toMeasurePoints(null).isEmpty())
        assertTrue(converter.toMeasurePoints("").isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun pointsCompareByValue() {
        val list = arrayListOf(MeasurePoint(3.0, 4.0, 1))
        list.remove(MeasurePoint(3.0, 4.0, 1))
        assertTrue(list.isEmpty())
    }
}

Ran a command
Room is generating Kotlin from the Java Measure entity, and KSP treats the generic element in a Java ArrayList<MeasurePoint> as nullable. Both the read path (lines 165 and 215) and the write path (lines 65 and 103) therefore expect ArrayList<MeasurePoint?>. My last change fixed one direction and broke the other.

The fix is to make the converter use ArrayList<MeasurePoint?> in both directions. I kept the entity in Java on purpose: rewriting it in Kotlin could change Room’s schema identity hash, which would crash on existing databases without a migration. The SunTimeWidget error is gone, so the build failed only on these four errors. Two files change, and nothing needs deleting. The README needs no change.

app/src/main/java/app/simple/positional/database/converters/MeasurePointConverter.kt
kotlin
package app.simple.positional.database.converters

import androidx.room.TypeConverter
import app.simple.positional.model.MeasurePoint

class MeasurePointConverter {
    @TypeConverter
    fun fromMeasurePoints(measurePoints: ArrayList<MeasurePoint?>): String =
        measurePoints.filterNotNull().joinToString("") { it.convertForDatabase() + ";" }

    @TypeConverter
    fun toMeasurePoints(data: String?): ArrayList<MeasurePoint?> =
        data.orEmpty().split(';').filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.mapTo(ArrayList<MeasurePoint?>()) { MeasurePoint.convertFromDatabase(it) }
}
app/src/test/java/app/simple/positional/database/converters/MeasurePointConverterTest.kt
kotlin
package app.simple.positional.database.converters

import app.simple.positional.model.MeasurePoint
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class MeasurePointConverterTest {
    private val converter = MeasurePointConverter()

    @Test
    fun roundTrip() {
        val points = arrayListOf<MeasurePoint?>(MeasurePoint(1.5, -2.25, 1), MeasurePoint(-45.0, 170.125, 2))
        val data = converter.fromMeasurePoints(points)
        assertEquals("1.5,-2.25,1;-45.0,170.125,2;", data)
        assertEquals(points, converter.toMeasurePoints(data))
    }

    @Test
    fun emptyNullAndNullElements() {
        assertEquals("", converter.fromMeasurePoints(arrayListOf()))
        assertEquals("1.0,2.0,1;", converter.fromMeasurePoints(arrayListOf(null, MeasurePoint(1.0, 2.0, 1))))
        assertTrue(converter.toMeasurePoints(null).isEmpty())
        assertTrue(converter.toMeasurePoints("").isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun pointsCompareByValue() {
        val list = arrayListOf(MeasurePoint(3.0, 4.0, 1))
        list.remove(MeasurePoint(3.0, 4.0, 1))
        assertTrue(list.isEmpty())
    }
}
